actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT 
    sub.submission_id,
    stu.full_name,
    a.title AS assignment_title,
    sub.ai_suggested_marks,
    sub.ai_feedback,
    sub.final_marks,
    sub.status,
    sub.file_path  
FROM sakec.submissions sub
JOIN sakec.students stu ON sub.prn = stu.prn
JOIN sakec.assignments a ON sub.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
JOIN sakec.teams t ON a.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN sakec.teachers tr ON t.teacher_id = tr.teacher_id
WHERE tr.email = {{appsmith.user.email}}
  AND sub.status = 'Graded'
  AND ({{ !SelectExperiment.selectedOptionValue }} OR a.assignment_id = {{ SelectExperiment.selectedOptionValue }})
	AND is_archived = FALSE;

UPDATE sakec.submissions
SET final_marks = {{Table1.updatedRow.final_marks}}, 
    status = 'Synced'
WHERE submission_id = {{Table1.updatedRow.submission_id}};

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM sakec.submissions sub
JOIN sakec.assignments a ON sub.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
JOIN sakec.teams t ON a.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN sakec.teachers tr ON t.teacher_id = tr.teacher_id
WHERE tr.email = {{appsmith.user.email}}
  AND sub.status = 'Graded';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM sakec.submissions sub
JOIN sakec.assignments a ON sub.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
JOIN sakec.teams t ON a.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN sakec.teachers tr ON t.teacher_id = tr.teacher_id
WHERE tr.email = {{appsmith.user.email}} 
  AND sub.status = 'Synced';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM sakec.submissions sub
JOIN sakec.assignments a ON sub.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
JOIN sakec.teams t ON a.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN sakec.teachers tr ON t.teacher_id = tr.teacher_id
WHERE tr.email = {{appsmith.user.email}}
  AND sub.status = 'Pending' 
  AND a.due_date < NOW();

SELECT 
    a.title as assignment,
    AVG(sub.ai_suggested_marks) as avg_ai,
    AVG(sub.final_marks) as avg_teacher
FROM sakec.submissions sub
JOIN sakec.assignments a ON sub.assignment_id = a.assignment_id
JOIN sakec.teams t ON a.team_id = t.team_id
JOIN sakec.teachers tr ON t.teacher_id = tr.teacher_id
WHERE tr.email = {{appsmith.user.email}}
  AND (sub.status = 'Synced' OR sub.status = 'Graded')
  AND ({{ !SelectExperiment.selectedOptionValue }} OR a.assignment_id = {{ SelectExperiment.selectedOptionValue }})
GROUP BY a.title;

SELECT 
    st.roll_no, 
    st.full_name, 
    sub.submission_time, 
    COALESCE(sub.status, 'Not Submitted') AS status,
    sub.is_late, 
    sub.ai_suggested_marks,
    sub.final_marks
FROM sakec.students st
LEFT JOIN sakec.submissions sub 
    ON st.prn = sub.prn 
    AND sub.assignment_id = {{SelectExperiment.selectedOptionValue}}
ORDER BY st.roll_no ASC;

SELECT 
    subject_name AS label, 
    team_id AS value
FROM sakec.teams
WHERE teacher_id = (SELECT teacher_id FROM sakec.teachers WHERE email = {{appsmith.store.user_email}})
AND status = 'active';

INSERT INTO sakec.teams (team_id, subject_name, teacher_id, semester, academic_year, status)
SELECT 
    {{InputMSTeamID.text}}, 
    {{InputSubjectName.text}}, 
    teacher_id, 
    {{SelectSemester.selectedOptionValue}}, 
    {{InputAcademicYear.text}},
    'active'
FROM sakec.teachers 
WHERE email = {{appsmith.store.user_email}};

SELECT 
    subject_name AS "Subject",
    semester AS "Semester",
    academic_year AS "Academic Year",
    team_id AS "MS Team ID"
FROM sakec.teams
WHERE teacher_id = (SELECT teacher_id FROM sakec.teachers WHERE email = {{appsmith.store.user_email}})
AND status = 'active';
